snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 Launch Trailer (PC/PS5/XBOX X|S)
snippet.description:
Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 is OUT NOW on PC via Steam, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. A Nintendo Switch 2 version is also coming soon. 

Play it now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115160/Warhammer_40000_Boltgun_2/ 

Obliterate heretics in the name of the Emperor in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2! Play as Ultramarine Malum Caedo or Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath in this sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun with MORE enemies, MORE weapons, and NEW ways to purge! 

💬 Join our Discord - https://discord.com/invite/aurochdigital 
⚔️ Find out more - https://aurochdigital.com/warhammer-40000-boltgun-2
